Hi Eva — thanks for the questions. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

1) Application logs (APP-24 / APP-27): retention is 90 days by default in hosted; exports include full request metadata including source IP. We can provide a redacted extract if you need PII removed — that takes ~1 business day to produce.

2) KMS / BYOK: customer-managed keys are supported in Redwood Private and in Dedicated with our KMS integration. Hosted (our default) supports CMK via partner KMS but not full BYOK HSM attestation. I flagged the exact controls in the spreadsheet.

3) FedRAMP moderate gap summary (top 5):
- Continuous monitoring : need integration with your monitoring tooling and policy alignment (remediation workflows)
- Configuration baselines: some image hardening and CIS checks are advisory on hosted
- Media protection / transfer controls: additional controls required for automated media inventory
- KMS attestations: HSM/BYOK attestation gaps for hosted customers
- Incident response playbooks: need customer-specific runbooks for joint incidents

Next steps: we will: 1) update the control-mapping.xlsx with a 'gap_impact' column and priority (by Dec 10), 2) prepare a redacted log extract sample (if you confirm), 3) lock the Dec 8 working session at 10:00am PST — attendees: Marissa, Karthik, Mina, Laura, Eva + Acme audit lead.

Looking forward to the session.

Mina Haddad
Compliance Program Manager
